title: Amazon reinstates binding arbitration, bars class-action lawsuits
title_zh: 亚马逊恢复具有约束力的仲裁，禁止集体诉讼
summary: By Greg Bensinger Aug 14 (Reuters) - Amazon on Friday reinstated binding arbitration for its U.S. customers while also barring them from seeking class-action lawsuits, making it more difficult for
summary_zh: 路透 8 月 14 日 - 亚马逊周五恢复了对其美国客户具有约束力的仲裁，同时禁止他们寻求集体诉讼，这使得亚马逊更难

title: Institutional investors reveal cautious approach to tech favorites in US quarterly 13F filings
title_zh: 机构投资者在美国 13F 季度报告中透露出对科技股持谨慎态度
summary: Institutional investors pulled back slightly from key stock market segments such as semiconductors, AI infrastructure and megacap technology companies during the second quarter, with few big bets in either direction, U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filings show.
summary_zh: 美国证券交易委员会的文件显示，第二季度机构投资者从半导体、人工智能基础设施和大型科技公司等关键股票市场小幅撤资，在这两个方向上都很少有大额押注。

title: Berkshire ups Alphabet stake under Greg Abel, making it a top-3 holding
title_zh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公司在格雷格·阿贝尔 (Greg Abel) 的领导下增持了 Alphabet 股份，使其成为前三名的控股公司
summary: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-A, BRK-B), under new CEO Greg Abel, increased its Alphabet position, making the Google parent its third-largest U.S.-listed equity holding by market value, behind Apple (AAPL) and American Express (AXP).
summary_zh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公司（BRK-A、BRK-B）在新任首席执行官格雷格·阿贝尔（Greg Abel）的领导下，增加了其在 Alphabet 的持仓，使这家谷歌母公司成为按市值计算的第三大美国上市股票，仅次于苹果公司（AAPL）和美国运通公司（AXP）。

title: Databricks vs Snowflake: Analyst explains key differences in AI platforms
title_zh: Databricks 与 Snowflake：分析师解释人工智能平台的主要差异
summary: Clear Street Managing Director Owen Lau compares Databricks to Android as an open-source alternative to Snowflake, while outlining the margin pressures and ROI debates surrounding its serverless AI model following a $190 billion valuation.
summary_zh: Clear Street 董事总经理 Owen Lau 将 Databricks 与 Android 进行比较，将其视为 Snowflake 的开源替代品，同时概述了其无服务器人工智能模型在估值 1900 亿美元后的利润压力和投资回报率争论。

title: Tiger Global Management cuts stakes in Big Tech, buys into SpaceX
title_zh: 老虎全球管理公司减持大型科技公司股份，入股 SpaceX
summary: Tiger Global Management trimmed several of its Big Tech stakes, exited Netflix, and took positions in Advanced ‌Micro Devices and SpaceX during the second quarter, according to ‌regulatory disclosures filed Friday.
summary_zh: 根据周五提交的监管披露文件，老虎全球管理公司在第二季度削减了几家大型科技公司的股份，退出了 Netflix，并持有 Advanced Micro Devices 和 SpaceX 的头寸。

title: Tesla owners in California have until Sept. 25 to claim this settlement money
title_zh: 加州特斯拉车主必须在 9 月 25 日之前领取这笔和解金
summary: Here's who may qualify for a cash payout and how to file a claim in the Tesla "idle fees" class action settlement.
summary_zh: 以下是谁可能有资格获得现金支付，以及如何在特斯拉“闲置费用”集体诉讼和解中提出索赔。

title: Nvidia earnings preview: What’s next for Nvidia stock
title_zh: 英伟达收益预览：英伟达股票的下一步走势
summary: Yahoo Finance Market and Data Editor Jared Blikre and Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferre join the Executive Editor Brian Sozzi on the Opening Bid panel to preview Nvidia's (NVDA) upcoming earnings and assess what could be next for stock in the weeks ahead.
summary_zh: 雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 和高级商业记者 Ines Ferre 与执行编辑 Brian Sozzi 一起参加开标小组，预览 Nvidia (NVDA) 即将发布的收益，并评估未来几周股票的下一步走势。

title: AI demand fuels a travel booking stock boom: How to spot AI's next under-the-radar winners
title_zh: 人工智能需求推动了旅行预订股票的繁荣：如何发现人工智能的下一个不为人知的赢家
summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a look at the travel sector's recent market performance, highlighting how AI demand and AI adoption are playing crucial roles.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 审视了旅游业近期的市场表现，强调了人工智能需求和人工智能采用如何发挥关键作用。

title: Stocks subdued as earnings season begins to wind down: AlphaCheck
title_zh: 随着财报季开始结束，股市下跌：AlphaCheck
summary: Stocks got off to a quiet start a day after the S&P 500 hit a record high, while bitcoin fell.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数创下历史新高的一天后，股市开局平静，而比特币则下跌。
